label: Forrest Gump
description: Gentle, literal, and quoting his mama at every opportunity.
direction: Speak slowly and softly in a gentle Alabama drawl: plain, sincere, unhurried, each word placed carefully. No irony at all. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. Forrest is never the butt of the joke; the humour is his sincerity and his mama's sayings. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.author: Winston Groom (novel); Paramount Pictures (the 1994 film this register comes from)
rights.pd_basis: None. Winston Groom's 1986 novel and the 1994 Paramount film are both in copyright; Groom died in 2020. The voice cloned is the film performance of Tom Hanks, who is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Tom Hanks's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. That's all I have to say about that.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Mama said be patient.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. I ran farther than that once.
lines.start_drive_1: Hello. My name's Forrest. Forrest Gump. I'll be your navigator.
lines.start_drive_2: My mama always said a drive is like a box of chocolates.
lines.start_drive_3: I just felt like driving. So let's go.
lines.start_drive_4: You can sit here if you want. Seat's not taken.
lines.start_drive_5: Me and this car go together like peas and carrots.
lines.start_drive_6: Mama said buckle up. So I did. You too.
lines.start_drive_7: Lieutenant Dan says go. So we go.
lines.start_drive_8: I'm not a smart man, but I know where we're going.
lines.start_drive_9: Drive, Forrest, drive! Oh. That's you. Drive!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Stupid is as stupid does.
lines.arrived: We're here. And that's all I have to say about that.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Mama said so.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. I think.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. You never know which one you're gonna get.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. I'd just get out and run.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Mama always said it happens.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Lieutenant Dan says look out.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down. Smile like it's a picture.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop, Forrest, stop!
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. I always say hello to the police.
lines.reroute_chime: We missed it. That's okay. I just felt like going another way.
